note: Adapted from Emerson 1925's English redescription of Neotropical material; the original description is Walker 1853 (Termes brevis, p. 524), of which the original was not obtained for this batch, and Emerson also notes that his synonymy list is taken from the literature and probably mixes more than one species. The same work gives a figure of the soldier (Fig. 29d—e) but no textual description of the soldier in the body, so there is no soldier section. Measurements in mm.

sections.label: Diagnostic characters
sections.text: Alate body length with wings 10.59—11.76 mm, without wings 5.00—5.88 mm; head medium reddish brown, paler at the sides and in front; antennae 16—18-segmented; pronotum narrower than the head; forewing length 8.65—8.74 mm, width 2.23—2.35 mm, cubitus with 11—17 branches. Much smaller than K. brevicollis; slightly smaller than K. dudleyi, the rest of the description being very close; K. cavifrons is smaller still and has 15-segmented antennae; in K. infumatus the cubitus curves upwards and joins the radius near the wing apex; this species agrees with the description of K. pseudobrevis and may be conspecific.

sections.label: Alate
sections.text: Head medium reddish brown, paler at the sides and in front, oval, covered with short hairs. Antennae 16—18-segmented, segment 2 about equal to segment 3 or 4. Compound eyes medium-sized, their shape varying from nearly triangular to round among individuals of the same nest, their lower margin about two-thirds of the eye diameter from the lower margin of the head. Ocelli medium-sized, touching the compound eye. Pronotum concolorous with the head, narrower than the head, the sides depressed and rounded, the posterior margin slightly concave, covered with short hairs. Wings transparent; anterior margin and radius brown, the radius with numerous accessory veins; subcosta and radius clear, media and cubitus unclear; media merging into the radius at about a quarter of the wing length from the wing apex; cubitus with 11—17 branches. Abdomen concolorous with the head, covered with short hairs. Measurements: body length with wings 10.59—11.76 mm, without wings 5.00—5.88 mm, head length 1.23—1.35 mm, head width 1.05—1.12 mm, antennal length 1.76—1.93 mm, compound eye diameter 0.11—0.13 mm, pronotum length 0.59—0.65 mm, width 0.94—1.00 mm, hind tibia length 0.90 mm, forewing length 8.65—8.74 mm, width 2.23—2.35 mm.
